compiled_state.title: As a sprint operator, I want a live end-to-end self-use validation emitting a real telemetry event from a /dso:review run and observing it landing in S3, so that sprint completion is gated on a real-world round-trip.
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: After the infrastructure and emit utility stories are complete, run `/dso:review` on a real diff during the d2f9 sprint with telemetry enabled (`dso-self` client_id), then verify: (a) the reviewer-dispatcher POST returned 2xx; (b) `aws s3 ls s3://<bucket>/dso-self/<UTC YYYY-MM-DD>/` shows at least one object; (c) the most recent object validates against the canonical schema. Capture evidence as a closure artifact.
**Why**: Self-use validation is the only way to catch integration-level bugs that unit tests miss; sc-9 requires a real `/dso:review` run within sprint scope, not a simulated one.
**Scope**:
- IN: Live emission test, evidence capture (curl response, s3 ls output, schema validation), closure artifact at `docs/findings/d2f9-live-validation-<timestamp>.md`.
- OUT: Building the components (covered by infrastructure, handler, emit utility, dispatcher stories).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, a `/dso:review` run during the d2f9 sprint produces a 2xx response from the deployed Lambda Function URL (captured in curl output).
  ← Satisfies: sc-9  (sc-9: "reviewer-dispatcher emits real telemetry event with 2xx response during d2f9 sprint")
- When this story is complete, `aws s3 ls "s3://$(bucket)/dso-self/$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)/"` returns at least 1 object after the `/dso:review` run.
  ← Satisfies: sc-9
- When this story is complete, the most recent S3 object at `s3://<bucket>/dso-self/<today>/` validates against the canonical schema in `telemetry-event-schema.md`.
  ← Satisfies: sc-9
- When this story is complete, a closure artifact exists at `docs/findings/d2f9-live-validation-<timestamp>.md` containing: (a) the canonical event JSON as POSTed, (b) the curl command and 2xx response, (c) `aws s3 ls dso-self/<today>/` output showing the landed object, (d) `aws s3 cp` of the S3 object with schema validation result confirming it exits 0.
  ← Satisfies: sc-9

## Considerations

- [Self-use] This story must be executed in the actual d2f9 sprint session, not simulated. It is the final end-to-end integration test.
- [Ordering] Cannot begin until aws-setup-bucket.sh, aws-setup-lambda.sh, aws-deploy-handler.sh, telemetry-emit.sh, and reviewer-dispatcher integration are all complete and deployed.
- [Sprint window] Verify the S3 object timestamp falls within the sprint window so the evidence is unambiguous.
- [Artifact location] Per project invariant, the closure artifact MUST NOT live under `plugins/dso/` — use `docs/findings/` instead.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
